context_title:
ow I need to write the index.html file. The main.py now has a task-based architecture where:

POST /api/chat → returns task_id
GET /api/task/{id}/stream → SSE stream
GET /api/task/{id}/poll → polling endpoint
The frontend needs to:

Send message → get task_id
Connect to SSE stream for that task
Handle reconnection (if SSE drops, reconnect and use polling cursor)
Show real-time tool execution
Show elapsed time (since it can run for 200 minutes)
Handle heartbeats
Allow stopping
